# Lucky Solanki

> Backend & AI engineer. The backend behind a better product.

Lucky Solanki builds backend foundations, recoverable integrations, realtime systems and AI agents. Based in Lucknow, India. The portfolio includes engineering case studies, client recommendations and a playable arcade.

## Engineering work
- [Blitzit](https://www.luckysolanki.com/work/blitzit): Backend foundation, integration plugins, shared text/voice action agent, scoped MCP tools and reversible writes. The case study distinguishes implementation evidence from measured outcomes and labels delivery status.
- [MaddyCustom](https://www.luckysolanki.com/work/maddycustom): Original custom commerce platform, payment recovery and internal production workflows. Business-scale figures are not attributed to software alone.
